errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this operation.

login.heroText: Minutes and Councils Management Information System. Filing, deliberation, signing and document integrity under the institutional identity.
login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Use the institutional email assigned by the Secretariat or the IT Office.

forgot.heroText: A reset link will be sent to the registered email if the account exists and is active.
forgot.title: Forgot password

reset.heroText: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
reset.title: Reset password
reset.invalidLink: The recovery link is not valid.

dashboard.clear: Nothing is waiting. The council is up to date.
dashboard.path: Follow this order: review the request, schedule the session and build the agenda, send the notice, hold the session, then prepare the minutes for signature.

hints.requestsPendingReview: Requests waiting for the secretary's review.
hints.approvedRequestsWithoutAgenda: Approved matters not yet placed on a session.
hints.upcomingSessions: Convened sessions still to be held.
hints.minutesInProgress: Minutes opened and not yet closed.
hints.minutesPendingSignature: Minutes waiting for the president's signature.

list.title: Requests
list.lead: Filing, review and tracking of matters for the council.
list.leadCouncil: Open each filed request. Approve it to place it on a session, or return it with a reason.
list.leadFaculty: File the matter. If the council returns it, correct it and send it again.
list.emptyText: Adjust the filters or file a new matter.

form.lead: Attachments must be PDF files of up to 10 MB.

detail.reviewLead: The council secretary approves, rejects or returns the request with a reason.
detail.approveMessage: The request will be ready to be added to an agenda.

hierarchy.title: Institutional hierarchy
hierarchy.lead: Set up the academic structure step by step: university, campus, faculty and program.
hierarchy.deleteMessage: Delete "{{name}}"? It will not be removed while it still has campuses, faculties, programs or council records.

university.title: University
university.description: Select the institution or register a new one.

campus.title: Campus
campus.description: Select the university campus where the faculty is located.

faculty.title: Faculty
faculty.description: Select the faculty the programs belong to.

program.title: Program
program.description: Browse and register the faculty's academic programs.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.lead: Scheduling, agenda and live session management.
sessions.path: Schedule the session, build the agenda, send the notice, hold it and generate the minutes.

now.agenda: Add the approved matters. When the agenda is ready, close it: that sends the notice.
now.cite: The agenda already has items. Close it to send the notice to the people summoned.
now.live: The notice was sent. Enter the room, mark who is present and record the decision on each item.
now.liveOpen: Stay in the room. Mark attendance, record each item and, when you are done, finish the session.
now.minutes: The session is over. Generate the minutes, review the text and send them for the president's signature.

liveHint.CONVENED: Press Start. Then mark who is present and record each item.
liveHint.STARTED: Mark who is present. On each item choose the decision, enter the votes and press Record. When finished, close the session.
liveHint.SUSPENDED: The session is paused. Resume to continue with the items, or finish if it will not go on.

new.title: Schedule session
new.lead: Choose the date, the place and who is summoned.
new.citeHint: Mark counselors and participants. They receive the notice when the agenda is closed.
new.nonePeople: There is nobody to summon in this faculty.
new.pickSomeone: Choose at least one person to summon.
new.pickVoter: Include the president or a counselor. They make up the quorum.

detail.title: Session of {{date}}
detail.generateMinutesMessage: The minutes will be compiled from the finished session.
detail.citedHint: These people were chosen when the session was scheduled and receive the notice.
detail.waitingHint: Find the request and add it to this session.
detail.noneWaiting: There are no approved requests left to include.
detail.closeAgendaMessage: The summons will be generated and sent to the members.
detail.subject: Subject
detail.emptyHint: Add approved requests to the agenda.

live.finishMessage: You will not be able to record more decisions after finishing.
live.changeReasonPlaceholder: Explain why the recorded decision is being changed
live.whoSitsHint: Only the people summoned when the session was scheduled are listed. Mark who is present.
live.decideHint: Choose the decision, enter the votes and press Record.

kindHint.EXTRAORDINARY: For what cannot wait: urgent items may be added.
kindHint.VIRTUAL: Consultation by email: no location and no deliberative quorum.
kindHint.EXPANDED: With guests who have a voice but no vote and do not count for the quorum.

urgentForm.title: Urgent item
urgentForm.hint: In an extraordinary council, items that do not come from a request can be added.
urgentForm.titleRequired: Enter the title of the urgent item

guests.title: Guests
guests.hint: They have a voice but no vote and do not count for the quorum.
guests.nameRequired: Enter the name of the guest

minutes.title: Minutes
minutes.lead: Drafting, review and signature before publication.

flow.DRAFT: The minutes are already filled in from the session. Change the text only if needed, save, and send them for signature.
flow.EDITING: Save the changes and, when the text is ready, send them for signature.
flow.PENDING_SIGNATURE: The minutes are waiting for a signature. The president approves them or returns them with a note.
flow.PUBLISHED: The minutes are signed and published. They are no longer edited.

minutes.emptyHint: Generate the minutes from a finished session.
minutes.previewHint: Generate the preview to review the PDF/A.

confirm.sendMessage: The minutes will move to pending signature.
confirm.signMessage: Signing publishes the minutes and locks them.

templates.title: Minutes templates
templates.lead: Only variables from the official catalog and well-formed XHTML.

settings.title: Settings
settings.letterheadHint: Sheet printed behind agreements and minutes. Use a letter-size image (PNG or JPG). An uploaded logo replaces the header logo.
settings.logoDefault: Using the logo of the sheet.
settings.councilTypesHint: The four types are fixed; only their display name can be changed.

agreements.title: Agreements
agreements.lead: Council agreements on the institutional letterhead, ready to sign.
agreements.subject: Subject
agreements.emptyHint: Create the first one with the New agreement button.
agreements.editorLead: Choose the type, fill in the case data and check the PDF on the right.
agreements.fieldsHint: Each value replaces its {{field}} in the text. Missing ones are highlighted in yellow in the PDF.
agreements.previewHint: It refreshes as you type. Use **text** for bold.
agreements.changeTypeMessage: The texts will be replaced with those of the new type. Case data with the same name is kept.
